    suggestion: Add start_tz text NOT NULL REFERENCES time_zones(name), holding a name such as 'America/Denver'. Keep local_start_at as an absolute timestamptz and derive local time with AT TIME ZONE start_tz (§9.2).
1 error(s), 0 warning(s), 0 note(s) in 0 entities and 0 queries
== 9.2-B unconstrained
events.sql:3: error: [9.2-B] events.start_tz holds the zone of local_start_at but nothing constrains it to IANA zone names
    suggestion: Constrain start_tz to IANA zone names such as 'America/Denver', with REFERENCES time_zones(name) or an enum generated from tzdata; abbreviations like MST and POSIX strings like 'UTC-7', whose sign PostgreSQL inverts, are ambiguous (§9.2).
1 error(s), 0 warning(s), 0 note(s) in 0 entities and 0 queries
== 9.3-B everything missing
stays.sql:3: error: [9.3-B] stays has the interval (valid_from, valid_to) but valid_to may be NULL without null=open saying the interval is still running; valid_to does not declare end=exclusive or end=inclusive; valid_from is a date but valid_to is a timestamptz
    suggestion: Declare end=exclusive (or inclusive) on valid_to, null=open on it if the interval may still be running, make both columns date, and compute durations as COALESCE(valid_to, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - valid_from on UTC values (§9.3).

== 9.4-A event times only
photos.sql:1: error: [9.4-A] photos is a file entity but lacks an ingestion-time field (when it arrived)
    suggestion: Add captured_at timestamptz (from EXIF DateTimeOriginal with OffsetTimeOriginal, or document metadata) and ingested_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). To deduplicate, add content_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL, or declare dedup=captured_at,ingested_at to compare by those times (§9.4).

    suggestion: Add captured_at timestamptz (from EXIF DateTimeOriginal with OffsetTimeOriginal, or document metadata) and ingested_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). To deduplicate, add content_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL, or declare dedup=captured_at,ingested_at to compare by those times (§9.4).

== 9.4-B by name
photos.sql:1: error: [9.4-B] photos deduplicates files by name (the only uniqueness is on filename), so copies with different names duplicate and different files with the same name collide
    suggestion: Deduplicate by content, with UNIQUE (content_sha256) or UNIQUE (<scope>, content_sha256), or by creation and ingestion times with dedup=. Keep the object key unique as a storage address if needed, but never use the file name (§9.4).

    suggestion: Deduplicate by content, with UNIQUE (content_sha256) or UNIQUE (<scope>, content_sha256), or by creation and ingestion times with dedup=. Keep the object key unique as a storage address if needed, but never use the file name (§9.4).

== 9.8-A two ways

    suggestion: Use timestamptz with its default precision of 6, and truncate in queries instead (§9.8).

    suggestion: Store it as timestamptz (default precision 6), or rename it to a _date if only the day matters (§9.8).
